# WILLER TRAVEL

> > WILLER TRAVEL is Japan's premier bus and travel booking platform offering highway buses, airport shuttles, tours, and travel guides across Tokyo, Osaka, and major destinations.

WILLER TRAVEL operates WILLER EXPRESS bus services with multiple seat classes (Luxia, Prime, Comodo) and provides comprehensive travel resources including hiking guides, outlet mall information, and ski resort access. The platform serves international travelers with multilingual support (English, Korean, Chinese, Vietnamese) for booking transportation and activities throughout Japan.

## Key Topics

- WILLER EXPRESS bus services
- Highway bus booking
- Airport shuttle (Narita, Haneda)
- Tokyo-Osaka routes
- Premium seating classes (Luxia, Prime, Comodo)
- Japan hiking trails
- Outlet mall access (Gotemba, Kobe, Tosu)
- Ski & snowboard tours (Nagano, Hakuba)
- Day trips from Tokyo/Osaka
- WILLER points rewards
- Ikebukuro transportation hub
- Multi-language booking support
- Travel payment methods
- Japan nature tourism

## User Guides & Booking Help

- [사용자 가이드](https://willer-travel.com/ko/guide): Comprehensive user guide for bus, tour, ferry bookings & eSIM activation
- [사용자 가이드 - 버스 예약 방법](https://willer-travel.com/ko/guide/booking/bus.html): Step-by-step bus booking tutorial covering payment & seat selection

## Airport Transportation

- [成田機場利木津巴士 池袋(東京)線](https://willer-travel.com/tw/airport-bus/ikebukuro-narita): Narita Airport to Ikebukuro limousine bus service with fares & schedule
- [나리타공항 셔틀버스 이케부쿠로(도쿄) 노선](https://willer-travel.com/ko/airport-bus/ikebukuro-narita): Narita Airport shuttle to Ikebukuro with fares, routes & stops
- [成田机场线巴士 池袋(东京)线 时刻表](https://willer-travel.com/cn/airport-bus/ikebukuro-narita/timetable.html): Narita-Ikebukuro airport bus timetable with operator details

## Bus Seat Types & Amenities

- [시트 소개 Luxia](https://willer-travel.com/ko/bus/seat/luxia): WILLER EXPRESS Luxia premium 3-row independent seat with amenities
- [座椅類型 Comodo](https://willer-travel.com/tw/bus/seat/comodo): WILLER EXPRESS Comodo 3-row independent seat with privacy curtains
- [Loại ghế: Prime](https://willer-travel.com/vn/bus/seat/prime): WILLER EXPRESS Prime seat type with upgraded amenities from Relax

## Outdoor Activities & Hiking

- [Japan Hiking Information](https://willer-travel.com/en/area/hiking): Japan hiking guide covering Shiretoko Five Lakes, Mt. Takao & trails
- [일본 하이킹 정보](https://willer-travel.com/ko/area/hiking): Japan hiking information covering Hokkaido, Tokyo, Yamanashi regions
- [日本徒步攻略指南](https://willer-travel.com/cn/area/hiking): Japan hiking guide featuring trails in Kobe, Takao & scenic spots

## Shopping & Seasonal Campaigns

- [日本顶级奥特莱斯特辑](https://willer-travel.com/cn/area/outlet-malls): Japan premium outlet malls guide featuring Kobe, Gotemba, Tosu locations
- [스키 & 스노보드 특집](https://willer-travel.com/ko/campaign/ski): Ski & snowboard campaign for Nagano, Hakuba resorts from Tokyo/Osaka
